3812: Donald Curtis, a confident ¼ Italian ¾ American pilot, is recruited in the Flying Pirates Alliance to take out their enemy Porco Rosso. His goal in life is to become a Hollywood star and become the President of the United States.
7747: Born Marco Pagot, Porco was an ace fighter pilot for the Italian Air Force in World War I. A curse has since given him the appearance of a pig, leading to the nickname Porco Rosso (Italian for "Red Pig").
8044: Fio was in America, but went to Milan to help out her grandfather Piccolo. Her grandfather is the owner of Piccolo S.P.A., where they build seaplanes. Fio is very talented and skilled for her age, and most importantly, passionate about her work. She greatly admires Porco Rosso.
8045: The owner of the famous Hotel Adriano. It is said that everyone, flying pirates, spies, smugglers, all behave only when Gina is around. She has a beautiful voice, and often performs at her restaurant for her guests. She is a childhood friend of Marco Paggot.
8046: Owner of Piccolo S.P.A., builder of seaplanes. He is protective of his granddaughter Fio, and constantly warns Porco Rosso to keep his hands to himself. Actually, he does trust Porco Rosso, and agreed that Fio should go with Porco Rosso for his fight with Curtis.
11300: A flying pirate who is tough on the exterior, but very soft on the inside. When he was kidnapping kindergarten girls from a passenger ship, he decided to kidnap all of them because he didn’t think it’d be nice for them to be separated from their friends.
269797: Ferrarin is a mayor of the Regia Aeronautica. He oparates the red plane MC72.
